title: Meadowbrook Stables
specs: Programs foster development of equestrian skills and character attributes such as kindness and responsibility
Riders must be at least 6 years old for all programs
Riders must bring their own riding gear including helmet, boots, britches or jodhpurs, and grooming kit
Meadowbrook horses can only accommodate riders up to 190 pounds
Summer lessons limited to riders age 13+
Group lessons have up to 6 riders depending on level
includes: Mounted riding instruction and unmounted horsemanship instruction included in camps
One instructor and one assistant for Young Horsemanship and Junior Short Stirrup levels
gap: Exact prices for summer camps and summer lessons not stated
blurb: Meadowbrook Stables provides group riding lessons and summer camps focusing on hunters, hunt seat equitation, and jumpers. Programs include mounted riding instruction and unmounted horsemanship instruction. The stable operates as a nonprofit with a mission of education, character development, and community engagement.
extraNote: Lessons held rain or shine; instructors decide if footing is safe for riding · No makeups for lessons missed due to tardiness; riders arriving more than 15 minutes late may not ride · Cancellations must be made with more than 24 hours notice to receive a makeup credit · No refunds for summer lessons; partial refunds for school year lessons only for medical or relocation reasons · No makeups or refunds for missed camp days
